refused: Dispatch is refused by the configured guard.
invalid_json: The dispatch guard request must contain exactly one valid JSON value with no unknown or duplicate fields.
required: dispatch_guard is required and must be an object.
targets_required: dispatch_guard.targets is required unless explicitly disabled.
targets_null: dispatch_guard.targets must be an array, not null.
enabled_required: dispatch_guard.enabled is required with non-empty targets.
invalid_policy: The dispatch guard policy is invalid.
read_failed: The dispatch guard could not be read.
save_failed: The dispatch guard could not be saved.
read_only_get: Read-only role cannot read the dispatch guard.
read_only_write: Read-only role cannot change the dispatch guard.
